coptic: Ⲡ̀ϭⲟⲓⲥ Ⲫ̀ⲛⲟⲩϯ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲛⲓϫⲟⲙ: ⲕⲟⲧⲕ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϫⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ: ⲁ̀ⲛⲁⲩ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϫⲉⲙⲡ̀ϣⲓⲛⲓ ⲛ̀ⲧⲁⲓⲃⲱ ⲛ̀ⲁ̀ⲗⲟⲗⲓ: ⲥⲉⲃⲧⲱⲧⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲏⲧⲥ ⲑⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥϭⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲕⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲛⲁⲙ.

translations.english: O Lord God of the powers, return and behold from heaven, and look and visit this vine, restore and establish Her, this which Your right hand has planted.
translations.arabic: أيها الرب إله القوات، إرجع واطلع من السماء، وانظر وتعهد هذه الكرمة، أصلحها وثبتها، هذه التي غرستها يمينك.

transliterations.english: Epshois Efnoti ente nigom: kotk o-woh gousht evol khen etfe: anav o-woh jemepshini entaivo enaloli: sevtots o-woh semneets thai etaschos enje tekouinam.

stanzas.coptic: ⲕⲟⲧⲕ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ϫⲟⲩϣⲧ ⲉ̀ⲃⲟⲗ ϧⲉⲛ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ:
ⲥⲉⲃⲧⲱⲧⲥ ⲟⲩⲟϩ ⲥⲉⲙⲛⲏⲧⲥ ⲑⲁⲓ ⲉ̀ⲧⲁⲥϭⲟⲥ ⲛ̀ϫⲉ ⲧⲉⲕⲟⲩⲓ̀ⲛⲁⲙ.

label: From 12 Baona to 9 Baba (19 June - 19/20 October), the response for the waters is said:

translations.english: Bless the waters of the river.

label: From 10 Baba to 10 Toba (20/21 October - 18/19 January), the response for the plants is said:

translations.english: Bless the plants and the herbs.

label: From 11 Toba to 11 Baona (19/20 January - June 18), the response for the fruits is said:

translations.english: Bless the air of the heaven.

label: Or the three responses are said combined:

coptic: Ⲥ̀ⲙⲟⲩ ⲛⲓⲁ̀ⲏⲣ ⲛ̀ⲧⲉ ⲧ̀ⲫⲉ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲙⲱⲟⲩ ⲙ̀ⲫ̀ⲓⲁⲣⲟ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲓϯ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲛⲓⲥⲓⲙ.

translations.english: Bless the airs of heaven, [and bless] the waters of the river, [and bless] the plants and the herbs.
translations.arabic: بارك أهوية السماء، ومياه النهر، والزروع والعشب.

transliterations.english: Esmou ni-aeer ente etfe nem nimoou emefiaro nem nisiti nem nisim.

coptic: Ⲙⲁⲣⲉ ⲡⲉⲕⲛⲁⲓ ⲛⲉⲙ ⲧⲉⲕϩⲓⲣⲏⲛⲏ ⲟⲓ ⲛ̀ⲥⲟⲃⲧ ⲙ̀ⲡⲉⲕⲗⲁⲟⲥ.

translations.english: May Your mercy and Your peace be a fortress to Your people.

transliterations.english: Mare peknai nem tekhireenee oi ensovt empeklaos.

coptic: Ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲟⲥ: Ⲕⲩⲣⲓⲟⲥ ⲥⲁⲃⲁⲱⲑ: ⲡ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲏⲥ ⲟ̀ ⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲏ̀ ⲅⲏ: ⲧⲏⲥ ⲁ̀ⲅⲓⲁⲥ ⲥⲟⲩ ⲇⲟⲝⲏⲥ.

translations.english: Holy holy holy, Lord of hosts, heaven and earth, are full of Your holy glory.
translations.arabic: قدوس قدوس قدوس، رب الصاباؤت، السماء والأرض، مملوءتان من مجدك الأقدس.

transliterations.english: Agios agios agios: Kirios savaoth: epleerees o ouranos ke ee gee: tees agias sou thoksees.

stanzas.coptic: ⲡ̀ⲗⲏⲣⲏⲥ ⲟ̀ ⲟⲩⲣⲁⲛⲟⲥ ⲕⲉ ⲏ̀ ⲅⲏ:
